examples.en: Going on a safari in Africa was truly a chance of a lifetime.
examples.zh: 去非洲野生動物園探險真的是一生難得的機會。

examples.en: Don't miss this offer; it's a chance of a lifetime to buy a house at this price.
examples.zh: 別錯過這個優惠；能以這個價格買房是一生難得的機會。

examples.en: She considered the scholarship to study abroad a chance of a lifetime.
examples.zh: 她認為出國留學的獎學金是一生難得的機會。

examples.en: Winning the lottery was a chance of a lifetime for the struggling artist.
examples.zh: 中樂透對這位苦苦掙扎的藝術家來說是一生難得的機會。

examples.en: The internship at the renowned tech company is truly a chance of a lifetime.
examples.zh: 在這家知名科技公司實習真是一生難得的機會。

examples.en: The door blew shut with a loud bang.
examples.zh: 門被風吹得砰的一聲關上了。

examples.en: He banged his fist on the table in frustration.
examples.zh: 他沮喪地用拳頭猛捶桌子。

examples.en: I accidentally banged my head against the cupboard.
examples.zh: 我不小心把頭猛撞到櫥櫃上。

examples.en: The fireworks exploded with a massive bang.
examples.zh: 煙火伴隨著巨大的砰聲爆炸了。

examples.en: He banged his knee against the edge of the desk.
examples.zh: 他的膝蓋猛撞到了書桌的邊緣。

examples.en: She bought a silk blouse to match her new skirt.
examples.zh: 她買了一件絲質女襯衫來搭配她的新裙子。

examples.en: The uniform consists of a white blouse and a dark blue skirt.
examples.zh: 制服包含一件白色的女襯衫和深藍色的裙子。

examples.en: You should iron your blouse before the interview.
examples.zh: 面試前你應該把女襯衫熨平。

examples.en: She accidentally spilled coffee on her favorite white blouse.
examples.zh: 她不小心把咖啡灑在最喜歡的白色女襯衫上。

examples.en: The boutique sells a variety of elegant blouses for women.
examples.zh: 這家精品店販售各種優雅的女裝襯衫。

examples.en: The firefighter received a medal for his bravery in saving the child.
examples.zh: 這名消防員因為拯救那名孩童的英勇行為而獲得獎章。

examples.en: It takes a lot of bravery to stand up for what you believe in.
examples.zh: 堅持自己的信念需要很大的勇氣。

examples.en: Her bravery during the crisis inspired everyone around her.
examples.zh: 她在危機展現的勇氣激勵了身邊的每個人。

examples.en: The soldier was honored for his remarkable bravery in battle.
examples.zh: 這名士兵因在戰鬥中的非凡勇氣而受到表揚。

examples.en: It requires bravery to speak the truth in difficult situations.
examples.zh: 在困難的情況下說出真相需要勇氣。

examples.en: I'd like a strawberry ice cream in a cone, please.
examples.zh: 請給我一個草莓冰淇淋甜筒。

examples.en: The traffic police placed orange cones around the accident scene.
examples.zh: 交警在事故現場周圍放置了橘色的交通錐。

examples.en: The volume of a cone can be calculated using a specific mathematical formula.
examples.zh: 圓錐體的體積可以使用特定的數學公式來計算。

examples.en: The pine tree dropped several cones onto the lawn.
examples.zh: 松樹掉落了幾個松果在草坪上。

examples.en: The dog had to wear a plastic cone after its surgery.
examples.zh: 這隻狗在手術後必須戴上塑膠頸圈（伊莉莎白圈）。

examples.en: We could hear the crickets chirping in the grass at night.
examples.zh: 晚上我們能聽到蟋蟀在草叢裡鳴叫。

examples.en: Cricket is a very popular sport in countries like India and Australia.
examples.zh: 板球在印度和澳洲等國家是非常受歡迎的運動。

examples.en: The boy caught a cricket and put it in a jar.
examples.zh: 那個男孩抓了一隻蟋蟀並把牠放進罐子裡。

examples.en: He spent his Sunday afternoon playing cricket with his friends.
examples.zh: 他星期天下午和朋友們一起打板球。

examples.en: The silent night was only disturbed by a lone cricket.
examples.zh: 寧靜的夜晚只被一隻孤獨的蟋蟀打擾。

examples.en: He managed to drag the heavy box into the room.
examples.zh: 他設法把那個重箱子拖進了房間。

examples.en: Don't drag your little brother into this argument.
examples.zh: 不要把你弟弟捲入這場爭論中。

examples.en: The old computer is becoming a real drag on my productivity.
examples.zh: 這台舊電腦成了我工作效率的真正阻礙。

examples.en: The dog tried to drag the heavy branch across the yard.
examples.zh: 狗試圖把沉重的樹枝拖過院子。

examples.en: I had to drag myself out of bed this morning because I was so tired.
examples.zh: 今天早上我太累了，只好硬把自己從床上拖起來。

examples.en: The government has been dragging its feet on environmental reforms.
examples.zh: 政府在環境改革方面一直拖拖拉拉。

examples.en: Stop dragging your feet and get your homework done!
examples.zh: 別再拖延了，快去把作業寫完！

examples.en: They dragged their heels when asked to clean up the classroom.
examples.zh: 被要求打掃教室時，他們慢吞吞的很不情願。

examples.en: If you keep dragging your feet, we will miss the train.
examples.zh: 如果你繼續拖拖拉拉，我們就會錯過火車。

examples.en: The committee dragged its heels in making a final decision.
examples.zh: 委員會在做出最終決定時拖泥帶水。

examples.en: Beat the egg whites until they are stiff.
examples.zh: 將蛋白打發直到變硬。

examples.en: This recipe calls for three egg whites and one whole egg.
examples.zh: 這份食譜需要三顆蛋白和一顆全蛋。

examples.en: Egg whites are a great source of protein and contain no fat.
examples.zh: 蛋白是極佳的蛋白質來源，而且不含脂肪。

examples.en: Whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
examples.zh: 將蛋白攪打至挺立起泡。

examples.en: She used only egg whites to make a healthier omelet.
examples.zh: 她只用蛋白來做更健康的歐姆蛋。

examples.en: We had a very enjoyable evening at the concert.
examples.zh: 我們在音樂會度過了一個非常愉快的夜晚。

examples.en: The teacher always tries to make learning English enjoyable.
examples.zh: 老師總是努力讓學習英文變得有趣。

examples.en: Reading a good book is one of the most enjoyable activities for me.
examples.zh: 閱讀一本好書對我來說是最令人愉快的活動之一。

examples.en: The movie was very enjoyable and kept me entertained throughout.
examples.zh: 這部電影非常有趣，讓我從頭到尾都覺得很享受。

examples.en: We had an enjoyable conversation over a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 我們喝著茶，進行了愉快的交談。

examples.en: She realized the designer bag she bought online was a fake.
examples.zh: 她發現她在網上買的名牌包是贗品。

examples.en: He used a fake ID to get into the club.
examples.zh: 他用了一張假身分證進入俱樂部。

examples.en: The student faked a stomachache to avoid taking the test.
examples.zh: 那個學生裝病胃痛以逃避考試。

examples.en: The painting turned out to be a clever fake rather than an original.
examples.zh: 這幅畫結果是一件巧妙的贗品，而不是真跡。

examples.en: She wore fake eyelashes to make her eyes look bigger.
examples.zh: 她戴了假睫毛讓眼睛看起來更大。

examples.en: A green grasshopper jumped across the path.
examples.zh: 一隻綠色的蚱蜢跳過了小徑。

examples.en: Grasshoppers can jump incredible distances compared to their body size.
examples.zh: 與體型相比，蚱蜢能跳躍驚人的距離。

examples.en: During the summer, the fields are full of grasshoppers.
examples.zh: 夏天時，田野裡滿是蚱蜢。

examples.en: The grasshopper blended perfectly with the green leaves.
examples.zh: 這隻蚱蜢與綠葉完美地融為一體。

examples.en: A swarm of grasshoppers destroyed the entire crop.
examples.zh: 一群蚱蜢摧毀了整片農作物。

examples.en: She arrived at the party with her little brother in tow.
examples.zh: 她帶著她的弟弟一起來到派對。

examples.en: The mother walked through the mall with three children in tow.
examples.zh: 那位母親身後跟著三個孩子穿過購物中心。

examples.en: The car broke down and had to be taken away in tow.
examples.zh: 車子拋錨了，必須被拖走。

examples.en: The celebrity arrived at the premiere with her entourage in tow.
examples.zh: 這位名流帶著她的隨從一起來到首映會。

examples.en: He walked into the office with a huge pile of documents in tow.
examples.zh: 他走進辦公室，隨後拖著一大疊文件。

examples.en: Christmas is a joyful time for many families.
examples.zh: 聖誕節對許多家庭來說是個歡樂的時光。

examples.en: They shed joyful tears when they heard the good news.
examples.zh: 聽到好消息時，他們流下了喜悅的眼淚。

examples.en: The choir sang a joyful song to celebrate the festival.
examples.zh: 合唱團唱了一首歡樂的歌來慶祝節日。

examples.en: The birth of their first child was a highly joyful event.
examples.zh: 他們第一個孩子的出生是一件非常喜悅的事。

examples.en: The children greeted their grandparents with joyful shouts.
examples.zh: 孩子們用歡樂的叫聲迎接他們的祖父母。

examples.en: He achieved more in his lifetime than most people could imagine.
examples.zh: 他一生中的成就超過了大多數人的想像。

examples.en: Building a successful business can be the work of a lifetime.
examples.zh: 建立一個成功的企業可能是一生的志業。

examples.en: You don't see a comet like that more than once in a lifetime.
examples.zh: 像那樣的彗星你一生難得見到超過一次。

examples.en: She spent a lifetime fighting for women's rights.
examples.zh: 她花了一生的時間為女權奮鬥。

examples.en: This sturdy leather bag is guaranteed to last a lifetime.
examples.zh: 這款堅固的皮包保證能用一輩子。

examples.en: The lighthouse guided the ships safely to the harbor during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，燈塔引導船隻安全駛入港口。

examples.en: We climbed to the top of the lighthouse to see the ocean view.
examples.zh: 我們爬到燈塔頂端欣賞海景。

examples.en: The old lighthouse has become a popular tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 這座古老的燈塔已經成為受歡迎的旅遊景點。

examples.en: The beam from the lighthouse cut through the thick fog.
examples.zh: 燈塔的光束穿透了濃霧。

examples.en: The lighthouse keeper lived a lonely but peaceful life.
examples.zh: 燈塔看守人過著孤獨但平靜的生活。

examples.en: He gave her a beautiful bouquet of white lilies.
examples.zh: 他送給她一束美麗的白百合。

examples.en: The pond in the park is covered with water lilies.
examples.zh: 公園裡的池塘長滿了睡蓮。

examples.en: Lilies are often used to symbolize purity and peace.
examples.zh: 百合花常被用來象徵純潔與和平。

examples.en: The elegant lily is often associated with funerals in some cultures.
examples.zh: 在某些文化中，優雅的百合花常與葬禮有關。

examples.en: She planted tiger lilies along the garden fence.
examples.zh: 她沿著花園圍欄種植了卷丹百合。

examples.en: The accident left him with a broken lower limb.
examples.zh: 這場意外導致他的一條下肢骨折。

examples.en: A heavy limb fell from the tree during the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風期間，一根粗大的樹枝從樹上掉了下來。

examples.en: Monkeys use their strong limbs to swing through the trees.
examples.zh: 猴子利用強壯的四肢在樹林間盪來盪去。

examples.en: The doctor carefully examined her injured limb.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細檢查了她受傷的肢體。

examples.en: A large limb snapped off the oak tree during the fierce storm.
examples.zh: 在猛烈的暴風雨中，橡樹上的一根大樹枝折斷了。

examples.en: The doctor gave the brave little boy a lollipop after the injection.
examples.zh: 打完針後，醫生給了這個勇敢的小男孩一根棒棒糖。

examples.en: She sucked on a cherry-flavored lollipop.
examples.zh: 她舔著一根櫻桃口味的棒棒糖。

examples.en: Eating too many lollipops can cause tooth decay.
examples.zh: 吃太多棒棒糖會導致蛀牙。

examples.en: He unwrapped a large, colorful lollipop at the carnival.
examples.zh: 他在嘉年華上拆開了一支五顏六色的大棒棒糖。

examples.en: The little girl dropped her lollipop in the dirt and started crying.
examples.zh: 小女孩把棒棒糖掉在泥土裡，開始哭了起來。

examples.en: The police are still searching for the missing child.
examples.zh: 警方仍在尋找失蹤的孩子。

examples.en: There is a missing piece in this jigsaw puzzle.
examples.zh: 這個拼圖少了一塊。

examples.en: I found my missing keys under the sofa.
examples.zh: 我在沙發底下找到了我不見的鑰匙。

examples.en: I spent hours looking for the missing document on my desk.
examples.zh: 我花了幾個小時在桌上尋找那份遺失的文件。

examples.en: Two climbers went missing after an avalanche hit the mountain.
examples.zh: 雪崩襲擊山脈後，兩名登山者失蹤了。

examples.en: His real name is Richard, but his friends call him by his nickname, Rich.
examples.zh: 他的真名是理查，但他的朋友們叫他的綽號「里奇」。

examples.en: Because of his speed, he was nicknamed 'The Flash'.
examples.zh: 因為他的速度很快，他被取了個綽號叫「閃電俠」。

examples.en: She hates the nickname her older brother gave her.
examples.zh: 她很討厭她哥哥給她取的綽號。

examples.en: His peers nicknamed him "Brain" because of his incredible intelligence.
examples.zh: 他的同儕因為他驚人的聰明才智給他取了個綽號叫「大腦」。

examples.en: The city is affectionately known by its nickname, the Big Apple.
examples.zh: 這座城市以其綽號「大蘋果」而為人所熟知。

examples.en: I always keep a writing pad on my desk to take notes.
examples.zh: 我總是在桌上放一本便簽本來記筆記。

examples.en: Make sure to wear knee pads when you go rollerblading.
examples.zh: 溜直排輪時，一定要戴上護膝。

examples.en: They padded the fragile item with bubble wrap before shipping.
examples.zh: 出貨前，他們用氣泡紙將易碎物品包裝填補好。

examples.en: He placed a heating pad on his sore back to relieve the pain.
examples.zh: 他把加熱護墊放在痠痛的背上以緩解疼痛。

examples.en: She jotted down the phone number on a small scratch pad.
examples.zh: 她在一個小巧的便簽本上草草記下了電話號碼。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take one pill after every meal.
examples.zh: 醫生囑咐我每餐後吃一顆藥丸。

examples.en: She had trouble swallowing the large vitamin pills.
examples.zh: 她很難吞下那些大顆的維他命藥丸。

examples.en: Sleeping pills should only be taken when absolutely necessary.
examples.zh: 安眠藥只有在絕對必要時才應該服用。

examples.en: You should not crush the pill before swallowing it.
examples.zh: 你在吞嚥藥丸之前不應該把它壓碎。

examples.en: The bitter pill was hard for the child to swallow.
examples.zh: 這顆苦藥丸讓小孩很難吞下。

examples.en: The boxer punched his opponent directly in the face.
examples.zh: 那名拳擊手直接一拳打在對手的臉上。

examples.en: Please punch your password into the keypad.
examples.zh: 請在鍵盤上輸入（按下）你的密碼。

examples.en: She used a hole punch to organize her documents in the binder.
examples.zh: 她用打洞器來整理活頁夾裡的檔。

examples.en: He threw a powerful punch that knocked his opponent down.
examples.zh: 他揮出一記有力的重拳，將對手擊倒。

examples.en: Please punch a hole in the top left corner of the paper.
examples.zh: 請在紙的左上角打一個洞。

examples.en: I had a queer feeling that someone was watching me in the dark.
examples.zh: 我有一種古怪的感覺，覺得黑暗中有人在看著我。

examples.en: The milk has a queer taste; it might have gone bad.
examples.zh: 這牛奶有一股奇怪的味道，可能壞掉了。

examples.en: It's queer how he suddenly changed his mind without any reason.
examples.zh: 他突然毫無理由地改變主意，真是奇怪。

examples.en: The abandoned house had a queer atmosphere that made everyone uneasy.
examples.zh: 這棟廢棄的房子有一種古怪的氣氛，讓每個人都感到不安。

examples.en: He gave me a queer look when I suggested the unusual idea.
examples.zh: 當我提出這個不尋常的主意時，他用一種奇怪的眼神看著我。

examples.en: We decided to roast a chicken for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 我們決定星期天的晚餐烤一隻雞。

examples.en: The aroma of roast beef filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 烤牛肉的香氣彌漫在廚房裡。

examples.en: We sat around the campfire and roasted marshmallows.
examples.zh: 我們坐在營火旁烤棉花糖。

examples.en: My mother prepared a delicious roast pork for the family gathering.
examples.zh: 我媽媽為家庭聚會準備了美味的烤豬肉。

examples.en: We bought a bag of freshly roasted coffee beans.
examples.zh: 我們買了一包新鮮烘焙的咖啡豆。

examples.en: Clean drinking water is scarce in many developing countries.
examples.zh: 在許多開發中國家，乾淨的飲用水是很缺乏的。

examples.en: Food became scarce during the harsh winter months.
examples.zh: 在嚴寒的冬季，食物變得匱乏。

examples.en: This particular species of bird is becoming increasingly scarce.
examples.zh: 這個特定品種的鳥類變得越來越稀有。

examples.en: Resources were scarce, so everyone had to ration their supplies.
examples.zh: 資源稀少，所以每個人都必須配給他們的物資。

examples.en: Genuine empathy seems to be a scarce commodity these days.
examples.zh: 如今，真誠的同理心似乎是一種稀缺的特質。

examples.en: She wrapped a thick woolen scarf around her neck to keep warm.
examples.zh: 她脖子上圍了一條厚羊毛圍巾來保暖。

examples.en: I bought a silk scarf as a souvenir from Italy.
examples.zh: 我買了一條絲質圍巾當作義大利的紀念品。

examples.en: He left his gloves and scarf on the train by mistake.
examples.zh: 他不小心把手套和圍巾忘在火車上了。

examples.en: She knitted a long red scarf for her boyfriend.
examples.zh: 她為男朋友織了一條長長的紅圍巾。

examples.en: The wind blew her scarf away while she was walking on the bridge.
examples.zh: 她走在橋上時，風把她的圍巾吹走了。

examples.en: The children couldn't sleep after watching that scary movie.
examples.zh: 孩子們看完那部恐怖電影後睡不著覺。

examples.en: It was a scary experience getting lost in the forest at night.
examples.zh: 晚上在森林裡迷路是個可怕的經歷。

examples.en: The loud thunder was quite scary for the dog.
examples.zh: 巨大的雷聲把狗嚇壞了。

examples.en: The rollercoaster ride was a bit too scary for my younger sister.
examples.zh: 搭雲霄飛車對我妹妹來說有點太可怕了。

examples.en: He told a scary ghost story around the campfire.
examples.zh: 他在營火旁講了一個嚇人的鬼故事。

examples.en: As a Boy Scout, he learned how to start a fire without matches.
examples.zh: 身為童子軍，他學會了如何在沒有火柴的情況下生火。

examples.en: They sent a scout ahead to check the enemy's position.
examples.zh: 他們先派了一名偵察兵去查看敵人的位置。

examples.en: The manager is scouting for new talents in high school basketball games.
examples.zh: 經理正在高中籃球比賽中物色（偵察）新人才。

examples.en: The talent scout discovered her singing in a small local bar.
examples.zh: 星探在當地一家小酒吧發現了正在唱歌的她。

examples.en: They scouted the area for a suitable place to set up camp.
examples.zh: 他們在該地區偵察，尋找適合紮營的地方。

examples.en: The tea is very hot, so sip it carefully.
examples.zh: 茶很燙，所以要小心啜飲。

examples.en: He took a small sip of the wine and nodded in approval.
examples.zh: 他喝了一小口葡萄酒，然後點頭表示讚許。

examples.en: She sat on the porch, sipping her coffee while reading a book.
examples.zh: 她坐在門廊上，邊看書邊啜飲著咖啡。

examples.en: She took a tentative sip of the hot soup to see if it was too spicy.
examples.zh: 她試探性地啜飲了一小口熱湯，看是否太辣。

examples.en: He sipped his cold beer slowly on the sunny terrace.
examples.zh: 他在陽光明媚的露臺上慢慢啜飲著冷啤酒。

examples.en: Would you like another slice of pizza?
examples.zh: 你想再來一片披薩嗎？

examples.en: Please slice the tomatoes thinly for the sandwich.
examples.zh: 請把番茄切成薄片來做三明治。

examples.en: I ate a slice of chocolate cake for dessert.
examples.zh: 我吃了一片巧克力蛋糕當甜點。

examples.en: He accidentally sliced his finger while cutting onions.
examples.zh: 他切洋蔥時不小心切到了手指。

examples.en: Could you cut me a thin slice of bread, please?
examples.zh: 請你幫我切一片薄薄的麵包好嗎？

examples.en: Be careful not to spill your coffee on the keyboard.
examples.zh: 小心別把咖啡灑在鍵盤上。

examples.en: The oil spill caused terrible damage to the marine ecosystem.
examples.zh: 石油外洩對海洋生態系統造成了可怕的破壞。

examples.en: Someone spilled water all over the floor.
examples.zh: 有人把水灑得滿地都是。

examples.en: He was so nervous that he spilled his drink on the floor.
examples.zh: 他緊張到把飲料灑在地板上。

examples.en: Tears spilled down her cheeks as she read the emotional letter.
examples.zh: 當她讀那封感人的信時，眼淚滑落了她的臉頰。

examples.en: The kids were splashing water at each other in the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子們在游泳池裡互相潑水。

examples.en: A passing car hit a puddle and splashed mud onto my new pants.
examples.zh: 一輛路過的車壓到水坑，把泥水濺到我的新褲子上。

examples.en: We heard a loud splash as he jumped into the river.
examples.zh: 他跳進河裡時，我們聽到了一聲巨大的水花聲。

examples.en: A drop of paint splashed onto his crisp white shirt.
examples.zh: 一滴油漆濺到了他挺括的白襯衫上。

examples.en: The news of their sudden marriage made quite a splash in the media.
examples.zh: 他們突然結婚的消息在媒體上引起了不小的轟動。

examples.en: The trail to the mountain top is very steep and difficult to climb.
examples.zh: 通往山頂的步道非常陡峭，很難攀爬。

examples.en: There was a steep drop in temperature overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之間氣溫急劇下降。

examples.en: The price of vegetables saw a steep increase after the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，蔬菜價格大幅上漲。

examples.en: We had to push our bicycles up the steep hill.
examples.zh: 我們不得不把腳踏車推上陡峭的山坡。

examples.en: The steep rise in housing prices makes it hard for young people to buy a home.
examples.zh: 房價的急劇上漲讓年輕人很難買房。

examples.en: The hikers struggled as they climbed the steep slope.
examples.zh: 登山者在爬那個陡坡時顯得很吃力。

examples.en: Beginners are advised to ski on the gentle slope.
examples.zh: 建議初學者在緩坡上滑雪。

examples.en: The road goes down a steep slope before reaching the valley.
examples.zh: 這條路在到達山谷之前會經過一段下坡的陡坡。

examples.en: The car struggled to climb the steep slope due to the icy road.
examples.zh: 由於路面結冰，車子很難爬上這個陡坡。

examples.en: The house was built on a gentle slope overlooking the sea.
examples.zh: 這棟房子建在一個俯瞰大海的緩坡上。

examples.en: A bee stung him on the arm while he was gardening.
examples.zh: 他在做園藝時，手臂被蜜蜂叮了。

examples.en: The smoke from the fire made my eyes sting.
examples.zh: 營火的煙讓我的眼睛感到刺痛。

examples.en: She removed the wasp's sting from his finger.
examples.zh: 她把黃蜂的刺針從他的手指上拔了出來。

examples.en: The alcohol on the wound caused a sharp sting.
examples.zh: 酒精碰到傷口引起了一陣劇烈的刺痛。

examples.en: Jellyfish can sting swimmers who get too close.
examples.zh: 水母會刺痛靠得太近的游泳者。

examples.en: The cut on his leg was so deep that it required five stitches.
examples.zh: 他腿上的傷口很深，需要縫五針。

examples.en: My grandmother taught me how to stitch a torn shirt.
examples.zh: 我奶奶教我如何縫補破掉的襯衫。

examples.en: The surgeon carefully stitched up the wound.
examples.zh: 外科醫生小心翼翼地把傷口縫合起來。

examples.en: She dropped a stitch while knitting the sweater.
examples.zh: 她織毛衣時漏了一針。

examples.en: He laughed so hard that he got a stitch in his side.
examples.zh: 他笑得太厲害，以至於肚子抽痛。

examples.en: The fishermen decided not to sail out because of the stormy weather.
examples.zh: 由於天氣是暴風雨，漁夫們決定不出海。

examples.en: They had a stormy relationship full of arguments and fights.
examples.zh: 他們的關係十分激烈，充滿了爭吵和打鬥。

examples.en: The stormy wind knocked down several old trees in the park.
examples.zh: 暴風吹倒了公園裡的幾棵老樹。

examples.en: The stormy sea tossed the small boat around like a toy.
examples.zh: 暴風雨肆虐的海洋把這艘小船像玩具一樣拋來拋去。

examples.en: The meeting ended after a stormy debate over the new policy.
examples.zh: 會議在對新政策進行了激烈的辯論後結束。

examples.en: The baby was happily sucking on his pacifier.
examples.zh: 嬰兒正開心地吸著奶嘴。

examples.en: The vacuum cleaner can suck up dust and small particles.
examples.zh: 這台吸塵器可以吸起灰塵和微小顆粒。

examples.en: It sucks that it rained all weekend and we couldn't go to the beach.
examples.zh: 整個週末都在下雨，我們不能去海灘，真是太糟了。

examples.en: The mosquito landed on his arm to suck his blood.
examples.zh: 蚊子停在他的手臂上吸血。

examples.en: It sucks to be stuck in traffic for two hours.
examples.zh: 塞車塞了兩個小時真是太糟糕了。

examples.en: The octopus uses the suckers on its tentacles to hold onto rocks.
examples.zh: 章魚利用觸手上的吸盤攀附在岩石上。

examples.en: Don't be a sucker; that email claiming you won a lottery is a scam.
examples.zh: 別當個容易受騙的人，那封說你中樂透的電子郵件是騙局。

examples.en: I'm a sucker for romantic comedies; I watch them all the time.
examples.zh: 我對浪漫喜劇毫無抵抗力（很容易被吸引），我總是看這種電影。

examples.en: He felt like a sucker for believing the salesman's lies.
examples.zh: 他覺得自己相信推銷員的謊言真是個容易受騙的傻瓜。

examples.en: The toy has rubber suckers that stick to the window.
examples.zh: 這個玩具有能黏在窗戶上的橡膠吸盤。

examples.en: Take two of these tablets every four hours for your fever.
examples.zh: 發燒時，每四小時服用兩片這種藥片。

examples.en: He uses his tablet for reading e-books and browsing the internet.
examples.zh: 他用平板電腦看電子書和上網。

examples.en: The museum displayed an ancient clay tablet with mysterious writing.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一塊刻有神秘文字的古代泥板。

examples.en: He swallowed a pain relief tablet with a glass of water.
examples.zh: 他配著一杯水吞下了一片止痛藥片。

examples.en: Tablets are convenient for watching movies while traveling.
examples.zh: 平板電腦在旅行時用來看電影很方便。

examples.en: The birds in the park are so tame that they will eat from your hand.
examples.zh: 公園裡的鳥兒很馴服，牠們會從你的手裡吃東西。

examples.en: It took months to tame the wild horse.
examples.zh: 馴服那匹野馬花了幾個月的時間。

examples.en: Compared to his last adventure, this hiking trip was rather tame.
examples.zh: 比起他上次的冒險，這次的徒步旅行算是相當平淡乏味。

examples.en: The lion at the zoo seemed surprisingly tame and lazy.
examples.zh: 動物園裡的獅子看起來出奇地馴服且慵懶。

examples.en: She tried to tame her frizzy hair with various hair products.
examples.zh: 她試著用各種美髮產品來撫平她毛躁的頭髮（使馴服）。

examples.en: We are very thankful for all the help you've given us.
examples.zh: 我們非常感激你給予我們的所有幫助。

examples.en: She was thankful that no one got hurt in the accident.
examples.zh: 她很感激這場意外中沒有人受傷。

examples.en: He offered a thankful prayer before eating his meal.
examples.zh: 他在用餐前作了一個感恩的祈禱。

examples.en: I am thankful for the opportunity to work with such a great team.
examples.zh: 我很感激有機會與這麼棒的團隊合作。

examples.en: The rescued hikers were thankful to be alive.
examples.zh: 獲救的登山客對能活著感到感激。

examples.en: Cleaning up after the party is a completely thankless task.
examples.zh: 派對結束後的清理工作完全是件吃力不討好的苦差事。

examples.en: Raising a teenager can sometimes feel like a thankless job.
examples.zh: 撫養青少年有時會讓人覺得是個不討好的工作。

examples.en: It is frustrating to help such a thankless person.
examples.zh: 幫助這麼一個不知感恩的人真是令人沮喪。

examples.en: Being an umpire is often a thankless task, as fans always complain.
examples.zh: 當裁判通常是個不討好的工作，因為球迷總是抱怨。

examples.en: She resigned from the committee, exhausted by the thankless nature of the role.
examples.zh: 她辭去了委員會的職務，對這個職位吃力不討好的性質感到疲憊。

examples.en: He drank a large glass of water to quench his thirst.
examples.zh: 他喝了一大杯水來解渴。

examples.en: The young student has an unquenchable thirst for knowledge.
examples.zh: 這位年輕學生對知識有著無法滿足的渴望。

examples.en: After running a marathon, her thirst was almost unbearable.
examples.zh: 跑完馬拉松後，她口渴得幾乎無法忍受。

examples.en: They wandered the desert, desperate with hunger and thirst.
examples.zh: 他們在沙漠中徘徊，飢渴難耐。

examples.en: Her thirst for adventure led her to travel the world.
examples.zh: 她對冒險的渴望驅使她環遊世界。

examples.en: Can I have some water? I'm feeling really thirsty.
examples.zh: 能給我點水嗎？我覺得非常口渴。

examples.en: The plants are looking a bit thirsty; we should water them.
examples.zh: 這些植物看起來有點缺水（渴了），我們應該澆澆水。

examples.en: He is thirsty for success and works late every night.
examples.zh: 他渴望成功，每天晚上都工作到很晚。

examples.en: The long hike left us hot, tired, and incredibly thirsty.
examples.zh: 長途跋涉讓我們感到炎熱、疲憊，而且極度口渴。

examples.en: The ambitious politician was thirsty for power.
examples.zh: 這位野心勃勃的政治家渴望權力。

examples.en: You can't park here, or your car will be towed away.
examples.zh: 你不能停在這裡，否則你的車會被拖走。

examples.en: The small boat was used to tow the damaged ship back to the harbor.
examples.zh: 這艘小船被用來將受損的船隻拖回港口。

examples.en: We had to call a truck to give our broken car a tow.
examples.zh: 我們不得不叫一輛卡車來拖我們拋錨的車。

examples.en: The tractor was used to tow the stuck vehicle out of the mud.
examples.zh: 牽引機被用來把卡住的車輛從泥淖中拖出來。

examples.en: He got a parking ticket and his car was towed.
examples.zh: 他收到了一張違規停車罰單，而且車子被拖走了。

examples.en: The tow truck arrived 20 minutes after we called for help.
examples.zh: 我們求救後20分鐘，拖吊車就到了。

examples.en: His car stalled on the highway, so he had to call a tow truck.
examples.zh: 他的車在高速公路上拋錨了，所以他必須叫一輛拖吊車。

examples.en: The illegally parked vehicle was removed by a tow truck.
examples.zh: 違規停放的車輛被拖吊車移走了。

examples.en: The tow truck driver carefully hooked up the damaged car.
examples.zh: 拖吊車司機小心翼翼地掛上受損的汽車。

examples.en: We waited on the side of the road for the tow truck to arrive.
examples.zh: 我們在路邊等待拖吊車的到來。

examples.en: I need you to be completely truthful with me about what happened.
examples.zh: 我需要你對所發生的事情完全誠實。

examples.en: The witness gave a truthful account of the accident in court.
examples.zh: 目擊者在法庭上真實地敘述了事故經過。

examples.en: She is known for being a truthful and reliable person.
examples.zh: 她以作為一個誠實可靠的人而聞名。

examples.en: You must promise to be truthful when you answer my questions.
examples.zh: 當你回答我的問題時，你必須答應要說實話。

examples.en: The documentary provided a truthful representation of the historical event.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片真實地呈現了這個歷史事件。

examples.en: She placed the fresh roses in a glass vase.
examples.zh: 她將新鮮的玫瑰花放在一個玻璃花瓶裡。

examples.en: The cat accidentally knocked the antique vase off the table.
examples.zh: 貓不小心把古董花瓶從桌上碰掉了。

examples.en: He bought a beautiful ceramic vase for his mother's birthday.
examples.zh: 他買了一個漂亮的陶瓷花瓶作為母親的生日禮物。

examples.en: The flowers in the vase began to wilt after a few days.
examples.zh: 花瓶裡的花幾天後開始枯萎。

examples.en: He filled the crystal vase with water before adding the tulips.
examples.zh: 他在加上鬱金香之前，先把水晶花瓶裝滿了水。

examples.en: The police officer wore a bulletproof vest for protection.
examples.zh: 員警穿著防彈背心以自我保護。

examples.en: He looked very formal in his suit and tie, complete with a vest.
examples.zh: 他穿著西裝打著領帶，還配上一件背心，看起來非常正式。

examples.en: It's chilly today; you'd better wear a vest under your jacket.
examples.zh: 今天有點冷，你最好在外套裡面穿件背心。

examples.en: A bright yellow reflective vest is required for construction workers.
examples.zh: 建築工人必須穿著亮黃色的反光背心。

examples.en: He unbuttoned his vest after eating a large meal.
examples.zh: 吃了一頓大餐後，他解開了背心的釦子。

examples.en: The garden was full of beautiful, blooming violets.
examples.zh: 花園裡開滿了美麗的紫羅蘭。

examples.en: She wore a stunning dress in a deep violet color.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件深藍紫色的絕美洋裝。

examples.en: Violet is my favorite color because it feels so calm and elegant.
examples.zh: 藍紫色是我最喜歡的顏色，因為它給人感覺平靜且優雅。

examples.en: The sunset painted the sky in shades of pink and violet.
examples.zh: 夕陽將天空染成了粉紅色和藍紫色的色調。

examples.en: She gently watered the potted violets on the windowsill.
examples.zh: 她輕輕地為窗台上的盆栽紫羅蘭澆水。

examples.en: Some people only eat the egg white and throw away the yolk.
examples.zh: 有些人只吃蛋白而把蛋黃扔掉。

examples.en: The recipe says to separate the yolk from the egg white.
examples.zh: 食譜上說要把蛋黃和蛋白分開。

examples.en: A bright yellow yolk means the egg is very fresh.
examples.zh: 鮮黃色的蛋黃表示雞蛋非常新鮮。

examples.en: The recipe uses three egg yolks to make the rich custard.
examples.zh: 這份食譜使用三個蛋黃來製作濃郁的卡士達醬。

examples.en: He prefers his fried eggs with a runny yolk.
examples.zh: 他喜歡吃蛋黃未熟透的煎蛋。

examples.en: Can you help me zip up the back of my dress?
examples.zh: 你能幫我把洋裝後面的拉鍊拉上嗎？

examples.en: It's freezing outside, so zip your jacket all the way up.
examples.zh: 外面冷極了，所以把你的外套拉鍊完全拉上。

examples.en: She closed the bag with a quick zip.
examples.zh: 她伴隨著一聲快速的拉鍊聲把包包關上。

examples.en: Make sure to zip the tent tightly to keep the bugs out.
examples.zh: 一定要把帳篷的拉鍊拉緊，以防止蟲子飛進來。

examples.en: She unzipped her purse to find her keys.
examples.zh: 她拉開錢包的拉鍊尋找鑰匙。

examples.en: The zipper on my favorite jacket is broken.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的外套上的拉鍊壞了。

examples.en: He bought a new pair of jeans with a sturdy zipper.
examples.zh: 他買了一件有一條堅固拉鍊的新牛仔褲。

examples.en: Make sure the zipper on your backpack is fully closed before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前確保你背包的拉鍊已經完全拉好。

examples.en: The zipper got stuck halfway down the jacket.
examples.zh: 拉鍊卡在外套一半的地方。

examples.en: He asked the tailor to replace the broken zipper on his pants.
examples.zh: 他請裁縫師更換他褲子上壞掉的拉鍊。
